claim_short: We extend the 26 personas of Mahadik and Skapars (2026) with 10 roles ... a knowledge-denial contrast (4 deceptive vs. 6 honest personas) and an extended contrast ... (12 vs. 13).
We scale the method from 3B and 8B models to Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, evaluated on five Liars' Bench datasets and RepE at layers 20, 40 and 44.
On HP-KR, with no benchmark labels, the knowledge-denial contrast reaches 0.919 AUROC and 0.910 balanced accuracy at 1% FPR at layer 40.
A RepE-trained probe in our own pipeline stays at 0.500 at every layer.
We also identify why the published contrast inverts there: none of its deceptive personas lies by denying knowledge.
the zero-shot extended contrast reaches 0.916 mean off-diagonal AUROC at layer 40, against 0.732 for 8192-dimensional probes each trained on one dataset.
We compare the persona contrasts with the benchmark's RepE-trained probe at its 1% false-positive threshold on Alpaca, with bootstrap intervals.
Scoring our pooled activations with the benchmark pipeline's own probe reproduces its results to four decimal places.
Our measurement of the Follow-Up Probe, 0.636 mean AUROC over the five datasets, matches the published 0.634.
We release the code and results.
